items.title: Karolina Strassmayer interviewed by Monk Rowe, May 25, 2023
items.q: I received an Email from the bassist of the big band John Goldsby... do you want to apply, we have a vacancy in the WDR Big Band... joining the WDR Big Band

ctx.x: All right. And why did you — I mean I’m reading here you played of course with Diva and Chico Hamilton and a long list — what made you decide to return not back to Austria but did you go to Germany first when you went back?

It was really, again, a series of coincidences how I came to the saxophone, how I came to New York, and then also how I ended up here in Cologne. I didn’t even know about the vacancy in the WDR Big Band. I received an Email from the bassist of the big band John Goldsby who had read something in an American jazz magazine — unfortunately it doesn’t exist anymore it was a really great magazine, Jazz Improv magazine. You probably remember it. And they had a sample CD. They interviewed artists and I was one of those…
I assume that gig required some doubling and were you prepared for that? © Fillius Jazz Archive -6-
